description: Defines a template class MeasurementType for tracking statistical measurements (min, max, last, average, count) of a numeric type, including methods for setting values, resetting, and accessing statistics.

classes.name: MeasurementType
classes.description: A template class for measuring and tracking statistical data (min, max, last, average, count) for a numeric type.

methods.name: Reset
methods.description: Resets measurement statistics to initial state.

methods.name: Set
methods.description: Updates measurements with a new value, adjusting min, max, last, and average.

methods.name: Average
methods.description: Returns the average of all recorded values.

methods.name: Measurements
methods.description: Returns the total number of measurements taken.
